description: Evaluate a node with OpenSCAP (SCAP Security Guide) and POST normalized compliance.v1 results to the console. Self-contained (bundles the scan-report adapter). Installs openscap-scanner + scap-security-guide when install=true.

console_url.description: Console base URL to POST results to (server-injected).

datastream.description: Path to the SCAP datastream. Defaults to the distro SSG content when unset.

install.description: Install openscap-scanner and scap-security-guide if missing.
